title: phyllorkis guttulata
intro: Phyllorkis guttulata, commonly known as the Ceylon orchid or Malabar orchid, is a plant species native to the Western Ghats of India and Sri Lanka. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and inflammation, due to its health benefits of reducing pain and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Phyllorkis guttulata include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and analgesic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Phyllorkis guttulata are responsible for its medicinal properties, and further research is needed to fully explore its potential therapeutic applications.
